blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Mark Villar has joined the 13-member majority bloc in the Senate, according to Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri. Zubiri made the confirmation after the Senate elected Villar as chairman of the Senate committee on public works and a member of the Commission on Appointments (CA) as part of the majority bloc.
